name: zhihu/web/topic-search-v3
description: Searches Zhihu topics by keyword and returns matching topic profiles, follower metrics, and highlighted text matches with pagination support.

free_quota.note: Shared across all free-quota APIs, resets 00:00 UTC.

readme: # Zhihu Topic Search (V3) API This API searches Zhihu topics by keyword. It returns a list of matching topics with their IDs, names, follower counts, and highlighted text. It needs one input, `keyword`. ## Use cases - Find the Zhihu topic ID for a brand or subject such as OpenAI. - Compare `follower_count` across topics that match the same keyword to see which has the largest audience. - Show matched terms in a search UI by using the `` tags in the highlight text. - Collect topic avatars and descriptions to build a directory of topics on one theme. ## Request ```bash curl -X POST "https://api.sandbase.ai/v1/api/zhihu/web/topic-search-v3" \ -H "Authorization: Bearer $SANDBASE_API_KEY" \ -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ -d '{"keyword": "OpenAI"}' ``` The result is returned in `outputs[0].data`. ## Parameters | Name | Type | Required | Description | |---|---|---|---| | `keyword` | string | Yes | Search Keywords | | `limit` | string | No | Number of topics per page | | `offset` | string | No | Offset | ## Example response Real response for the request above, trimmed: lists keep their first item and long strings are cut. ```json { "ab_params": "dm_ai_search_safe=1;dm_recency_ab=1;sb_cr=1;sb_vip_tag=1;sb_sku_time=1;dm_correc…", "data": [ { "highlight": { "description": "由 Elon Musk, Peter Thiel, Sam Altman", "title": "OpenAI" }, "hit_labels": null, "id": "20083046", "index": 0, "object": { "agreed_count": 0, "ai_ranking_list_url": "", "aliases": [], "attached_info_bytes": "OvEBCgtwbGFjZWhvbGRlchIgZjYyOWJjOGQwZDRmMDljZmNkMDgzMWYyYTFkNzI3OTQYAiIGMTgwNDc2…", "avatar_url": "https://pic1.zhimg.com/80/v2-4a85355a9ea1acc515ddabc2b3d1d4b1_qhd.jpg", "description": "由 Elon Musk, Peter Thiel, Sam Altman", "excerpt": "由 Elon Musk, Peter Thiel, Sam Altman", "follower_count": 6574 }, "type": "search_result" } ], "domain_info": { "first_category": "" }, "filter_items": null, "hit_labels": null, "is_brand_word": false, "is_koc_words": false, "item_in_view": [ { "index": 5, "token": "b62a7302…", "type": "user_survey" } ], "paging": { "is_end": false, "next": "https://api.zhihu.com/search_v3?advert_count=0&correction=1&filter_fields=&gk_ve…" }, "pendant": null, "related_search_result": [], "search_action_info": { "attached_info_bytes": "OqQBEiBmNjI5YmM4ZDBkNGYwOWNmY2QwODMxZjJhMWQ3Mjc5NEoGb3BlbmFpUABYA2ABagZPcGVuQUlw…", "isfeed": false, "lc_idx": 20, "search_hash_id": "f629bc8d0d4f09cfcd0831f2a1d72794" } } ``` ## Response fields | Field | Meaning | |---|---| | `data[].id` | ID of the matching topic, as a string. | | `data[].type` | Result type. Here it is `search_result`. | | `data[].index` | Position of the result in the list, starting at 0. | | `data[].highlight.title` | Topic title with the matched keyword wrapped in `` tags. | | `data[].highlight.description` | Topic description with matches highlighted. It can be an empty string. | | `data[].object.description / data[].object.excerpt` | Short text describing the topic. Both can be empty. | | `data[].object.follower_count` | Number of followers of the topic. Many topics show `0`. | | `data[].object.avatar_url` | Image URL for the topic. | | `data[].object.aliases` | List of alternative names for the topic. It is empty in this response. | | `paging.is_end / paging.next` | `is_end` tells you whether more results exist. `next` is a URL for the next page of results. | ## Notes - Use `limit` and `offset` to page through results. Both are sent as strings, and `limit` defaults to `25` and `offset` to `0`. - Check `paging.is_end` to know when to stop paging. - Strip the `` tags from `highlight.title` if you need the plain topic name. - To search content instead of topics, try [Zhihu Article Search](/apis/zhihu/web/article-search-v3) or [Zhihu Search Suggestions](/apis/zhihu/web/search-suggest). ## Pricing $0.001 per successful call. Failed calls are not charged. It is included in the daily free quota of each organization. ## Related APIs - [Zhihu AI Search Stream](/apis/zhihu/web/ai-search-stream): Returns streaming AI search results from Zhihu based on a query prompt. - [Zhihu Answer Details](/apis/zhihu/web/answer-detail): Retrieves detailed information for a specific Zhihu answer using its numeric ID, including answer text, timestamps, and share links. - [Zhihu Article Search](/apis/zhihu/web/article-search-v3): Search Zhihu articles and answers by keyword and get titles, excerpts, authors, vote and comment counts, with sorting, content type and time filters plus offse…
